column1: # Each hospital runs its own HIS instance with its own locale settings
# date of birth is exported eight different ways across the network.
# H002 and H004 are the interesting pair: 03/04/1985 means 3 April at H002 and
# 4 March at H004. The ambiguity is unresolvable from the value alone
# Silver parses dates using the *source hospital* rather than guessing per row. Any
# pipeline that applies one global date format silently corrupts 12% of birth dates
# and then fails to match those patients in the MPI.
